title: Efficiently Scaling LLM Reasoning Programs with Certaindex
authors_zh: Yichao Fu、Junda Chen、Siqi Zhu、Zheyu Fu、Zhongdongming Dai、Yonghao Zhuang、Yian Ma、Aurick Qiao、Tajana Rosing、Ion Stoica、Hao Zhang（机构：加州大学圣迭戈分校、卡内基梅隆大学、Snowflake、加州大学伯克利分校）
paper_type_zh: 测试时推理效率与服务系统研究
best_for_zh: 部署自适应早停和推理任务调度的读者。
one_line: Certaindex detects stabilized reasoning answers to stop or reallocate inference compute without lowering accuracy.
Certaindex 检测推理答案是否已稳定，以停止或重分配计算而不降低准确率。
why: It connects a model-side stability signal to practical token allocation and serving throughput.
inclusion_reason: It converts answer stabilization into an early-exit and scheduling signal for test-time reasoning computation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Chain-of-thought sampling, self-consistency, search, and other reasoning programs often spend a fixed number of tokens or rollouts on every request. Yet an answer may settle early for an easy question, whereas a difficult question may still change after several apparently plausible intermediate answers. A uniform budget therefore wastes inference computation on already stable cases, while a simple length cap risks stopping precisely the cases that still need exploration.

The paper asks whether a serving system can recognize, without being tied to one decoding or search algorithm, when an additional interval of test-time computation is unlikely to alter the final answer. The target is not a direct estimate of correctness: it is a decision about the expected value of more reasoning. Intermediate answer evolution is consequently made into a signal for early exit, token redistribution, and scheduling across concurrent requests.

思维链采样、自一致性、搜索以及其他推理程序，常常为每个请求投入固定数量的令牌或采样轨迹。然而，简单问题的答案可能很早就已稳定；困难问题即使经历了几个看似合理的中间答案，结论仍可能继续改变。因此，统一预算会把推理计算浪费在已经稳定的案例上，而简单的长度上限又可能恰好截断仍需要继续探索的案例。

论文研究服务系统能否不依赖某一种解码或搜索算法，识别继续投入一段测试时计算何时不太可能改变最终答案。它要估计的不是答案是否正确，而是额外推理是否仍有预期价值。为此，论文把中间答案的演化转化为早停、令牌再分配以及并发请求调度的信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Certaindex measures how reliably a reasoning program's intermediate answers have stabilized. When successive probes converge on the same answer, the score is high and another segment of inference is less likely to change the output; when the answer is still moving, the score remains low and the request keeps its opportunity to consume computation. This separates the operational question of whether to continue from a claim that the model has proved its answer correct.

The central design choice is to expose answer stability as an algorithm-agnostic systems interface. Rather than building a prompt-specific stopping rule for one sampler, the same score can govern early exit, allocate tokens among requests with different uncertainty, and coordinate stages of a larger reasoning program. Test-time scaling then becomes selective: additional computation is directed toward cases whose answer trajectory has not yet settled.

Certaindex 衡量推理程序的中间答案已经多么可靠地趋于稳定。当连续探测得到的答案收敛到同一结论时，该分数较高，继续进行一段推理不太可能改变输出；当答案仍在变化时，分数保持较低，请求便仍有机会消耗更多计算。这样做把“是否继续”的运行决策，与“模型是否已经证明答案正确”的主张区分开来。

核心设计是把答案稳定性暴露为与算法无关的系统接口。它不是为某一个采样器设计的提示词停止规则；同一个分数可以控制早停，在不确定性不同的请求之间分配令牌，并协调更大型推理程序的多个阶段。于是，测试时扩展变成选择性的：额外计算被投入到答案轨迹尚未稳定的案例中。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method inserts periodic probes into a running reasoning program and asks what answer the program would give at each checkpoint. It compares the resulting answer sequence and normalizes the observed stabilization into Certaindex, a proxy for whether another compute interval is likely to produce a different terminal answer. The procedure can be applied to programs based on chain-of-thought, repeated sampling, tree search, or other multi-step inference patterns because it operates on answer evolution rather than their internal search rule.

Dynasor consumes this metric as a scheduling input. A request with a stable answer can leave the system early, while a request whose answer has not settled receives further tokens or rollouts. The implementation also uses the signal for dynamic allocation among requests and for gang scheduling of multi-stage programs. No separate reward model is required by the stated mechanism; the operational feedback comes from the program's own intermediate answers.

该方法在运行中的推理程序里插入周期性探测，并在每个检查点询问程序此时会给出什么答案。它比较由此得到的答案序列，再把观察到的稳定程度归一化为 Certaindex；该数值代理下一段计算是否可能产生不同的最终答案。由于方法关注的是答案演化而非内部搜索规则，它可以用于基于思维链、重复采样、树搜索或其他多步推理模式的程序。

Dynasor 将这个指标作为调度输入。答案已经稳定的请求可以提前离开系统，而答案尚未稳定的请求获得更多令牌或采样轨迹。该实现还把信号用于请求之间的动态分配，以及多阶段程序的协同调度。按论文描述，这一机制不需要额外的奖励模型；运行反馈来自推理程序自身的中间答案。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper evaluates the stability signal across chain-of-thought, self-consistency, Monte Carlo tree search, and related reasoning programs. Its comparisons test whether stabilized intermediate answers expose inference intervals that no longer alter the final result, rather than merely measuring whether a shorter completion is possible. The reported evidence indicates that the signal can identify surplus token use while preserving the accuracy reported for the corresponding reasoning workloads.

In the Dynasor integration, the authors report up to 50% lower computation and up to 3.3 times higher throughput on real workloads without an accuracy reduction. These are system-level results: their meaning depends on the selected workloads, model behavior, probe cadence, thresholds, batching policy, and service constraints. A reproduction should therefore report accuracy, consumed tokens, latency, and throughput together instead of treating one headline efficiency number as a task-independent guarantee.

这篇 NeurIPS 论文在思维链、自一致性、蒙特卡洛树搜索以及相关推理程序上评估该稳定性信号。比较所检验的是：稳定的中间答案能否暴露那些即使继续推理也不会改变最终结果的计算区间，而不只是判断能否生成更短的回答。论文报告的证据表明，该信号能够识别多余的令牌消耗，同时保持相应推理工作负载所报告的准确率。

在 Dynasor 的整合实验中，作者报告真实工作负载上最高可降低 50% 计算、提高至多 3.3 倍吞吐，且没有准确率下降。这些属于系统层结果：其含义取决于所选工作负载、模型行为、探测频率、阈值、批处理策略和服务约束。因此，复现时应同时报告准确率、消耗令牌、延迟和吞吐，而不应把单一的效率数字当作与任务无关的保证。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier efficiency controls commonly specialize to one decoding strategy, one search procedure, or a separately trained verifier. Certaindex instead takes a directly observable property of the running program—whether its intermediate answers are settling—and makes it a shared control signal across different reasoning algorithms. This gives the stopping decision an explicit empirical object: answer changes over the computation already performed.

The paper further connects that signal to serving decisions rather than limiting it to a benchmark early-exit curve. In Dynasor, answer stability affects which request receives more tokens, which request exits, and how stages are coordinated. The novelty is thus the joint framing of a model-side behavioral metric and a systems scheduler: test-time scaling is treated as allocation of finite computation to requests whose output may still change.

既有效率控制通常专门适配某一种解码策略、某一种搜索过程，或依赖另行训练的验证器。Certaindex 则利用运行中程序可直接观察到的属性——其中间答案是否正在稳定——并把它变成不同推理算法共享的控制信号。这样，停止决策有了明确的经验对象：已经完成的计算过程中，答案是否仍在发生变化。

论文进一步把这一信号连接到服务决策，而不局限于基准上的早停曲线。在 Dynasor 中，答案稳定性影响哪个请求获得更多令牌、哪个请求退出，以及多个阶段如何协调。因此，新意在于同时提出模型侧的行为指标和系统侧的调度器：测试时扩展被看作把有限计算分配给输出仍可能改变的请求。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Answer stabilization is not answer correctness: a model can confidently settle on a wrong response, and probe formatting may affect detected stability. Thresholds also need calibration for a model, task, and serving stack. The reported efficiency gains therefore should not be read as a universal license to truncate every long reasoning trace.
答案稳定不等于答案正确：模型可能自信地稳定在错误响应上，探测格式也可能影响检测到的稳定性。阈值还需要针对模型、任务和服务栈校准。因此，报告的效率收益不应被理解为可以普遍截断所有长推理轨迹。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use Certaindex when a service supports repeated or long-horizon reasoning and needs per-request early exit. Log probe answers, stability values, exit decisions, consumed tokens, latency, and correctness, then check whether stabilized wrong answers cluster by task or model version. Dynasor provides an official implementation surface for this deployment-oriented evaluation.
当服务支持重复或长时程推理，并需要按请求早停时，可使用 Certaindex。应记录探测答案、稳定性数值、退出决定、消耗令牌、延迟和正确性，再检查稳定但错误的答案是否按任务或模型版本聚集。Dynasor 为这种面向部署的评估提供官方实现接口。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Check how intermediate answers are extracted, how the metric is normalized, and how thresholds are selected without leaking test labels. Report accuracy together with token savings and latency for every early-exit threshold. The key audit question is whether stability predicts no future answer change, not merely a shorter trace.
应检查中间答案如何抽取、指标如何归一化，以及阈值怎样在不泄露测试标签的情况下选择。每个早停阈值都应同时报告准确率、令牌节省和延迟。关键审计问题是稳定性是否预测未来答案不再变化，而不只是轨迹更短。
